tasks.label: verify-all
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $env:Path="$env:USERPROFILE\.local\bin;C:\Program Files\GitHub CLI;$env:Path"; Set-Location 'C:\Users\colorfire-ai-395\pr\cubecloud-skills-bundle-kit'; '=== fast-audit ==='; powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File bin\fast-audit.ps1 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 2; '=== mcp-smoke ==='; powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File bin\mcp-smoke-test.ps1 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 2; '=== counters ==='; $onDisk=(gci "$env:USERPROFILE\.agents\skills" -Directory).Count; $cl=(gci "$env:USERPROFILE\.claude\skills" -Directory).Count; $mf=(gc setup\skills-list.csv | ? { $_ -match '^[a-zA-Z][^|#]*\|' }).Count; $pk=(gci "$env:USERPROFILE\.agents\skills._disabled" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count; "onDisk=$onDisk mirror=$cl manifest=$mf parked=$pk"; if ($onDisk -eq $cl -and $onDisk -eq $mf) { 'COUNTERS RECONCILED' } else { 'COUNTERS DIVERGED' }
